name: visual-phrases
title: Find what a phrase describes
description: Finds when a phrase you write ("two cats sleeping on a couch") describes what a video shows, with an image-text model.

find.description: Finds when a phrase describes what a video shows ("two cats sleeping on a couch", "a red car", "a person skiing"), with an image-text model and no language model. Any phrase works, with no fixed list of classes. For each phrase it gives one appearance each time it holds, with the first picture and the time; a phrase that stays true is one appearance.
find.title: Find what a phrase describes

media.title: Video
media.description: The video: a stored file or a video as media.open gives it, or a path in text. VideoCraw decodes a colour picture of it every second.

phrases.title: Phrases to look for
phrases.description: What to look for, in words. Descriptive phrases score best ("a photo of two cats sleeping on a couch"); a negation or a count ("no people", "exactly three") does not work well.

device.title: Run on
device.description: Where the picture model runs: cpu (the default) or gpu / auto, which use the graphics card (on Windows, any DirectX 12 card). The graphics card was about 3 times faster here, but this model is quantised (int8) and its numbers differ a little from the processor's, so its scores differ too: try it on your material before relying on it. The phrase model always runs on the processor. A card that cannot be used falls back to the processor; the result says what ran.

enumTitles.auto: Automatic (graphics card if there is a discrete one)

minConfidence.title: Least confidence
minConfidence.description: How sure the model must be that a phrase describes a picture (default 0.1). The scores of this kind of model are low for short phrases: a good match is often 0.2 to 0.6.

gapMs.title: Longest gap
gapMs.description: How long a phrase can stop being true before it counts as over; if it comes back that is another appearance (default 2000).

minSamples.title: Fewest pictures
minSamples.description: In how few pictures (a second apart) a phrase is still reported, so a flicker is not (default 1).

phrase.title: Phrase
phrase.description: The phrase as it was given, without the spaces round it.

startMs.title: First shown
startMs.description: When the picture where it first holds is shown, in the time of the video.

endMs.title: Last shown
endMs.description: When the last picture it holds in stops being shown.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The surest the model was of it in any picture of the appearance.

samples.title: Pictures it was seen in
samples.description: In how many pictures it held.

picture.title: Picture
picture.description: The first picture of the appearance: a stored PNG.

samples.title: Pictures it was seen in
samples.description: How many pictures were looked at.

device.title: What it ran on
device.description: What the picture model really ran on: device (cpu or directml:N), name (the graphics card, if one was used) and fallback (why the graphics card was not used, if it was asked for).

failures.description: A param is wrong, or media is missing or not a video VideoCraw decoded for the plugin.
The video has no picture, a file cannot be read, or the model cannot be loaded.
A model file could not be downloaded (they are fetched once, on first use). Trying again may work.
